notes: Producer prices cover Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Yemen. United Arab Emirates does not report producer prices to FAOSTAT.

Healthy diet indicators (July 2026 (SOFI report)) cover Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates. Yemen is not estimated by FAO or the World Bank (no recent price-comparison data).
Prevalence of unaffordability is reported for Qatar, United Arab Emirates only.
32 annual values missing from FAOSTAT were filled with the average of at least 6 monthly FAOSTAT prices, and 124 annual values identical to the previous year's figure were replaced the same way.

Some annual prices still repeat the previous year's value where no monthly data exist (Bahrain 18 of 22 series, Kuwait 14 of 32 series, Oman 24 of 24 series, Qatar 17 of 35 series, Saudi Arabia 2 of 38 series); these are shown as reported.
591 live-weight ("biological") meat values and 95 non-food values were excluded.
40 USD values that did not match the official currency peg (Saudi Arabia 2022, Saudi Arabia 2023) were recomputed from local-currency prices.
Yemen local-currency prices are strongly affected by exchange-rate depreciation; compare Yemen in USD for levels and treat changes with caution.
111 year-on-year local-currency price changes exceed ±60% and are flagged for verification.
